title: Chetz wallet ledger entry
description: One append-only coin movement in a player's wallet ledger (`users/{uid}/ledger/{id}`). Clients create entries with UUID v7 ids; the `syncLedger` function validates them against the economy bounds, stores accepted and rejected entries and recomputes the authoritative balance. Server-authored entries (RevenueCat purchases `rc_*`, the starting wallet) live in the same collection and carry a `server` block; clients never send `server`.

id.description: UUID v7 (time-ordered) generated by the client.

amount.description: Signed coin delta: positive for earn/purchase, negative for spend/refund.

balanceAfter.description: Balance as seen by the writer after applying this entry (the server overwrites it with the authoritative value).

refId.description: What the entry refers to: puzzle id for earn_complete/earn_perfect/earn_daily, ad placement or SSV id for earn_ad, achievement id, hint/item id for spends, product id for purchases; null when not applicable.
